SetMemoryScalingConfig.memSpec.memUsageUpperThreshold: Average memory utilization threshold that triggers automatic scale-up, in %. Values: 70, 80, 90.
SetMemoryScalingConfig.memSpec.memUsageDownThreshold: Average memory utilization threshold that triggers automatic scale-down, in %. Values: 20, 30, 40.
SetMemoryScalingConfig.memSpec.observationWindowSizeForUpper: Observation window. The value consists of a number and a time unit suffix. Supported database instances and their values are as follows (suffix m indicates minutes, h indicates hours): 1m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m.
SetMemoryScalingConfig.memSpec.observationWindowSizeForDown: Observation window. The value consists of a number and a time unit suffix. Supported database instances and their values are as follows (suffix m indicates minutes, h indicates hours): 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m.
